title: Lattice-Forced Sexual Dimorphism—Deriving Male/Female Chassis from Hexagonal Chirality and 32-Bit Bus Constraints
abstract:

Dimorphism proven as mandatory topological resolution—32-bit word cannot execute on neutral chassis without stripping gears.
